name: Weather
description: Current weather and a short forecast for any city, via Open-Meteo (free, no key needed)
context:
Weather comes from Open-Meteo, free and keyless. Never ask the owner for coordinates.
{{WEATHER_HOME}}
For any other place, or home without saved coordinates, look the city up first (city name only, URL-encoded; check the country in the result, and add a country to the question only if the first match is clearly wrong):
curl -s "https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?count=1&language=en&name=<city>"
Then the forecast for its latitude and longitude:
curl -s "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=<lat>&longitude=<lon>&current=temperature_2m,weather_code,wind_speed_10m&daily=weather_code,temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max&forecast_days=3&temperature_unit={{TEMP_UNIT}}&timezone=auto"
Weather codes: 0=Clear, 1-3=Partly cloudy, 45-48=Fog, 51-55=Drizzle, 61-65=Rain, 71-75=Snow, 80-82=Showers, 95+=Thunderstorm
Say which place you answered for when it is not home.
